entries.description: One new whole static dry chain-bucket irrigation-lift appearance: two vertically separated open-rim wheels on full axles and a grounded braced timber frame carry two continuous closed capsule-shaped chain-route bands and a fixed row of ten whole thick open buckets. entries.description: One original fixed half-retracted interior pocket-door module.
